function [Ad,Bd,Cd,Dd] = dv_coefficients_Tustin(dv_test_K,dv_test_tau,dv_test_T,dv_test_wp)
%dv_coefficients_Tustin
%    [Ad,Bd,Cd,Dd] = dv_coefficients_Tustin(dv_test_K,DV_TEST_TAU,dv_test_T,DV_TEST_WP)

%    This function was generated by the Symbolic Math Toolbox version 26.1.
%    2026-09-10 22:31:24

t2 = dv_test_tau.*2.0;
t3 = dv_test_T+t2;
t4 = 1.0./t3;
Ad = dv_test_T.*t4.*-2.0+1.0;
if nargout > 1
    Bd = dv_test_T.*t2.*t4;
end
if nargout > 2
    Cd = dv_test_K.*t4.*2.0;
end
if nargout > 3
    Dd = dv_test_K.*dv_test_T.*t4;
end
end
